crossRefs.note: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
“Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
“Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
translations.bsb: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man.
translations.kjv: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
translations.asv: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.
